caption_rows.source: Draw a thick outline round the control that has keyboard focus, so you can follow Tab from control to control.
Focus outlines
Hold every animated backdrop still and turn off ripples, click ripples, popup waves and mouse gravity. Clear it to get your previous motion settings back.
Keyboard
Make all text in spaCR larger or smaller. This is the same setting as Font scale on the General tab.
Reduce motion
See every keyboard shortcut and change the key for any of them.
Settings that make spaCR easier to see, read and use from the keyboard. Screen readers announce every control by name.
Stronger focus outlines
Use the High contrast theme: white text and outlines on black with a yellow accent. Clear it to go back to the theme you had. The Theme control under Appearance shows the same choice.
